head: U-shape spring nut
notes: Search-result summaries tie 3846854 to Mid America Motorworks C2 cowl-vent/rocker-molding kits, but inconsistently (once as the #10 pan-head screw paired with U-nut 3848300, once as the U-nut OEM number). Product pages returned 404, so no exact quote; AIM calls it NUT. No size recorded. Round 4: GM P&A 30A (Oct 1970) catalog text gives 3846854 as 'NUT moulding No 10 16 spl U shape sprg', i.e. #10-16 U-shape spring nut for moldings; matches AIM 'NUT' and vendor screw+U-nut kits. A Mid America/Amazon listing calls 3846854 the #10 pan-head screws (and 3848300 the U-nuts); #10 agrees, kind disagrees. Catalog OCR, one primary source.
